facts.name: Successor Ownership Transfer
facts.sentence: If the trust resigns as owner, the successor owner shall be the successor trustee then serving.

facts.name: Joint Survivorship Policy Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Joint Survivorship Whole Life' policy refers to whole life insurance that covers two lives and pays death proceeds upon the death of the last surviving insured.

facts.name: Definition of First Death
facts.sentence: The term 'First Death' refers to the earlier death of the two insureds.

facts.name: Definition of Second Death
facts.sentence: The term 'Second Death' refers to the later death of the two insureds.

facts.name: Survivorship Period Definition
facts.sentence: The 'Survivorship Period' refers to the time between First Death and Second Death during which policy administration continues.

facts.name: Two-Life Insurance Coverage
facts.sentence: This policy insures two lives.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: The death benefit under this policy is payable only upon the Second Death.

facts.name: No Benefit on First Death Without Rider
facts.sentence: No death benefit is payable upon the First Death unless a rider specifically provides otherwise.

facts.name: First-to-Die Premium Waiver
facts.sentence: A First-to-Die Premium Waiver Rider is attached to the policy.

facts.name: Premium Waiver After First Death
facts.sentence: Following the First Death, all future premiums under the policy are waived while the policy remains in force.

facts.name: Participating Policy Feature
facts.sentence: This policy is participating.

facts.name: Dividend Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: This policy may pay dividends if declared by the insurer.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates according to the policy values table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $120,800.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 20 is $309,600.

facts.name: Dividend Cash Option
facts.sentence: Dividends, if declared, may be taken in cash.

facts.name: Dividends Left to Accumulate
facts.sentence: Dividends, if declared, may be left to accumulate.

facts.name: Dividends for Paid-Up Additions
facts.sentence: Dividends, if declared, may be used to purchase paid-up additions.

facts.name: Dividend Accumulation Option
facts.sentence: The current dividend option is to accumulate at interest.

facts.name: Semiannual Premium Payment
facts.sentence: Semiannual premiums are payable in advance.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies after the first premium.

facts.name: Rider Waives Post-First Death Premiums
facts.sentence: After First Death, no further premium is required due to the attached rider.

facts.name: Post-First Death Interest Accrual
facts.sentence: Policy debt continues to accrue interest if outstanding after First Death.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Loans are available after the first policy year.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 90% of cash surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate is 5% per annum, compounded annually.

facts.name: Loan Rights Restriction
facts.sentence: During the Survivorship Period, only the owner may exercise loan rights.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Components
facts.sentence: Upon Second Death, the payment includes the base face amount.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Includes Paid-Up Additions
facts.sentence: Upon Second Death, the payment includes paid-up additions.

facts.name: Dividend Accrual in Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Upon Second Death, the payment includes dividend accumulations.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Adjustment
facts.sentence: Upon Second Death, the payment subtracts policy debt.

facts.name: Post-First Death Continuation
facts.sentence: Upon First Death, the policy will be endorsed to reflect continuation on the life of the surviving insured only for administrative purposes.

facts.name: Preservation of Second-to-Die Benefit
facts.sentence: Upon First Death, the second-to-die benefit structure is preserved.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Payout
facts.sentence: Settlement is payable to the trust beneficiary designated in the policy.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: After 3 full policy years, the owner may elect cash surrender.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Option
facts.sentence: After 3 full policy years, the owner may elect reduced paid-up survivorship insurance.

facts.name: No Extended Term Insurance
facts.sentence: Extended term insurance is not available.

facts.name: Reinstatement Within 5 Years
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 5 years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability of the surviving insured if First Death has occurred.

facts.name: Reinstatement Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability of both insureds if both are living at reinstatement.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If both insureds die by suicide within 2 years from the Effective Date, liability is limited to premiums paid minus indebtedness.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Exception
facts.sentence: If one insured dies by suicide within 2 years and the other dies later, the exclusion does not apply.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability
facts.sentence: If both insureds die by suicide within two years from the effective date, the insurer's liability is limited to premiums paid minus indebtedness.

facts.name: Suicide Death – One Insured
facts.sentence: If one insured dies by suicide within two years and the other insured dies later, the policy remains in force under all other terms.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of the age of either insured results in adjustment of values based on the correct issue ages.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Right
facts.sentence: The owner may return the policy within thirty days after delivery for a full refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After Two Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after two years during the lifetime of both insureds.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: The policy is incontestable after two years during the lifetime of both insureds, except in cases of nonpayment or fraud.

facts.name: Trust Assignment Requirement
facts.sentence: Assignment by the trust owner must be in writing.

facts.name: Insurer Approval for Assignment
facts.sentence: Assignment by the trust owner must be accepted by the insurer.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Location
facts.sentence: The policy was issued at Wilmington, Delaware.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: The policy was issued on May 12, 2026.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Authority
facts.sentence: The president of Northriver Assurance issued the policy.

facts.sentence: The risk class of the insured is Preferred Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $10,950.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Payments
facts.sentence: The payment frequency for the premium is monthly.

facts.name: 15-Year Premium Term
facts.sentence: The premium payment period is 15 years.

facts.name: Final Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The final premium due date is August 15, 2040.

facts.name: Maturity Date
facts.sentence: The maturity date of the policy is April 2, 2101.

facts.name: Maturity Age: 121

facts.name: Policy Owner Entity
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Apex Design Partners LLC.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the policy is Apex Design Partners LLC.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Ownership
facts.sentence: The percentage share of the primary beneficiary is 100%.

facts.name: Succession via Merger/Conversion
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary of the policy is a successor business entity formed through merger or conversion.

facts.name: Buy-Sell Funding Endorsement
facts.sentence: A Buy-Sell Funding Endorsement is attached to the policy.

facts.name: Business Continuation Definition
facts.sentence: Business Continuation Whole Life refers to whole life insurance intended to fund a buy-sell arrangement or key-person continuity plan.

facts.name: Entity Purchase Agreement Definition
facts.sentence: An Entity Purchase Agreement refers to a business agreement where the owner entity can use proceeds to redeem or purchase an ownership interest.

facts.name: Key Person Disability Waiver
facts.sentence: A Key Person Disability Waiver Rider refers to a rider that waives premiums if the insured becomes totally disabled as defined in the rider.

facts.name: Restricted Assignment Definition
facts.sentence: A Restricted Assignment refers to an assignment permitted only to a lender approved by the owner entity.

facts.name: Business Continuation Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy is designed for business continuation planning.

facts.name: Limited Premium Payment Term
facts.sentence: Premiums under this policy are payable for 15 years only.

facts.name: Non-Participating Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is non-participating.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Restriction
facts.sentence: The Buy-Sell Funding Endorsement restricts beneficiary changes without the written consent of the owner entity.

facts.name: Key Person Disability Waiver
facts.sentence: A Key Person Disability Waiver Rider is attached to the policy.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation Mechanism
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates according to the policy value table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $63,500.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 15
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 15 is $118,900.

facts.name: Cash Value Collateral Use
facts.sentence: Cash value may be used by the owner entity as collateral.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at end of Year 10 is $63,500.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 15
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value at end of Year 15 is $118,900.

facts.name: Cash Value Collateral Use
facts.sentence: Cash value may be used by the owner entity as collateral.

facts.name: Cash Value Collateral Consent
facts.sentence: Use of cash value as collateral requires lender consent.

facts.name: Cash Value Collateral Use
facts.sentence: Use of cash value as collateral requires compliance with company filing requirements.

facts.name: Premium Payment Method
facts.sentence: Monthly premiums are payable by electronic transfer.

facts.name: Grace Period After First Premium
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies after the first premium.

facts.name: Premium Waiver for Disability
facts.sentence: If the insured becomes totally disabled as defined in the rider, future premiums falling due during the period of approved disability will be waived.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Loans are available after the first policy year.

facts.name: Max Loan Limit: 85%
facts.sentence: Maximum loan amount is 85% of cash surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Loan interest rate is 5.75% per annum.

facts.name: Insured Cannot Initiate Loans Without Ownership
facts.sentence: No loan may be made by the insured unless they are also the owner.

facts.name: Insured Ownership Requirement
facts.sentence: No partial surrender may be made by the insured unless they are also the owner.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Ownership Requirement
facts.sentence: No beneficiary change may be made by the insured unless they are also the owner.

facts.name: Assignment Priority Over Owner Requests
facts.sentence: Any restricted assignment on file takes priority over unsecured owner requests to the extent of the assignee's interest.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the company will pay the owner-beneficiary the Base Face Amount.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Death benefit payment is reduced by policy debt.

facts.name: Death Benefit Subject to Assignments
facts.sentence: Death benefit payment is subject to existing assignments.

facts.name: Business Continuation Support
facts.sentence: Proceeds are intended to support obligations under the owner entity's business continuation agreement.

facts.name: Death Benefit Purpose
facts.sentence: Proceeds are intended to support obligations under the owner entity's buy-sell agreement.

facts.name: No Admin Responsibility for Buy-Sell Agreements
facts.sentence: The company is not responsible for administration of the business continuation agreement.

facts.name: Buy-Sell Agreement Administration Limitation
facts.sentence: The company is not responsible for administration of the buy-sell agreement.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: After 3 full years, the owner may elect cash surrender.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Option
facts.sentence: After 3 full years, the owner may elect reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: Automatic Premium Loan Election
facts.sentence: After 3 full years, the owner may elect automatic premium loan if elected by endorsement.

facts.name: No Extended Term Insurance
facts.sentence: Extended term insurance is not available.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 3 years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Insurability
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Payment Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue amounts.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of 5% interest on overdue amounts.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within 2 years from the Effective Date limits the company’s liability to premiums paid less debt.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age results in adjustment of values accordingly.

facts.name: Sex Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of sex results in adjustment of values accordingly.

facts.name: Buy-Sell Agreement Filing Requirement
facts.sentence: The company is not bound by any buy-sell agreement not filed with the company.

facts.name: Free Look Period Right
facts.sentence: This policy may be returned during the free look period.

facts.name: Misstatement Adjustments
facts.sentence: A misstatement of age or sex results in adjustments to policy values.

facts.name: Unfiled Buy-Sell Agreement Exemption
facts.sentence: The company is not bound by any buy-sell agreement that has not been filed with the company.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: This policy may be returned within 15 days after delivery.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Policy
facts.sentence: A return of this policy within 15 days after delivery entitles the holder to a full refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Policy Part of Entire Contract
facts.sentence: This policy constitutes part of the entire contract.

facts.name: Endorsements Part of Contract
facts.sentence: Endorsements to this policy constitute part of the entire contract.

facts.name: Riders Part of Entire Contract
facts.sentence: Riders to this policy constitute part of the entire contract.

facts.name: Application Part of Entire Contract
facts.sentence: The application for this policy constitutes part of the entire contract.

facts.name: Entire Contract Definition
facts.sentence: The entire contract consists of this policy, endorsements, riders, and the application.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Location
facts.sentence: This policy was issued at Chicago, Illinois.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: This policy was issued on August 15, 2026.

facts.name: Presidential Authorization

facts.sentence: The policy number is CSL-WL-2026-9728.

facts.name: Effective Policy Start Date
facts.sentence: The effective date of the policy is September 1, 2026.

facts.name: Participating Whole Life with Charitable Benefit
facts.sentence: The policy type is Participating Whole Life with Charitable Benefit.

facts.name: Insured Name: Benjamin Arthur Cole
facts.sentence: The name of the insured person is Benjamin Arthur Cole.

facts.name: Insured Birth Date
facts.sentence: The date of birth of the insured person is March 11, 1979.

facts.name: Insured Issue Age
facts.sentence: The issue age of the insured person is 47.

facts.name: Standard Non-Tobacco Risk Class
facts.sentence: The risk class of the insured person is Standard Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Base Face Amount
facts.sentence: The base face amount of the policy is $400,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $5,760.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payment
facts.sentence: The payment frequency for premiums is annual.

facts.name: Premium Payment Until Age 99
facts.sentence: The premium payment period extends until age 99.

facts.name: Maturity Date Confirmation
facts.sentence: The maturity date of the policy is March 11, 2100.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identification
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Benjamin Arthur Cole.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the policy is Rachel Cole.

facts.name: Marital Relationship Confirmation
facts.sentence: Rachel Cole is married to the insured person.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The percentage share of the primary beneficiary is 100%.

facts.name: Charitable Supplemental Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The charitable supplemental beneficiary is Mercy Harbor Foundation.

facts.name: Charitable Share Percentage
facts.sentence: The percentage share of the charitable supplemental beneficiary is 1%

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is Cole Family Trust.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: The percentage share of the contingent beneficiary is 100%.

facts.name: Charitable Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Charitable Benefit' refers to an additional death benefit paid to a named charitable organization.

facts.name: Charitable Benefit Exclusion
facts.sentence: The 'Charitable Benefit' does not reduce the Base Face Amount payable to the primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Participating Policy Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Participating Policy' is defined as a policy eligible for dividends when declared.

facts.name: Stewardship Dividend Option
facts.sentence: The 'Stewardship Dividend Option' is a dividend option where declared dividends are automatically donated to a designated charitable organization.

facts.name: Approved Charity Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Approved Charity' is defined as an organization accepted by Covenant Steward Life under company rules.

facts.name: Participating Whole Life Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is a participating whole life policy.

facts.name: Charitable Benefit Endorsement
facts.sentence: This policy includes an attached Charitable Benefit Endorsement.

facts.name: Charitable Supplemental Payout
facts.sentence: The Charitable Supplemental Beneficiary is entitled to an additional 1% of the Base Face Amount upon the insured’s death.

facts.name: Max Charitable Payout Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount payable to the Charitable Supplemental Beneficiary is $10,000.

facts.name: Charitable Supplemental Endorsement
facts.sentence: The charitable supplemental amount is provided through endorsement.

facts.name: Non-Diminishing Charitable Payout
facts.sentence: The charitable supplemental amount does not reduce the amount payable to other beneficiaries.

facts.name: Dividend Options Available
facts.sentence: Dividend options available include: Cash Payment, Premium Reduction, Paid-Up Additions, and Stewardship Dividend Option.

facts.name: Stewardship Dividend Option Selected
facts.sentence: The current selected dividend option is the Stewardship Dividend Option.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation Mechanism
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates according to the policy values table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $41.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation Mechanism
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates according to the policy values table.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 10
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 10 is $41,600.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value at Year 20
facts.sentence: The guaranteed cash value at the end of Year 20 is $102,700.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Dividends Based on Company Experience
facts.sentence: Dividends depend on company experience.

facts.name: Stewardship Dividend Distribution
facts.sentence: Under the Stewardship Dividend Option, any declared dividend is remitted to the designated Approved Charity.

facts.name: Charity Designation Change
facts.sentence: The owner can change the Stewardship Dividend Option.

facts.name: Dividend Redistribution After Change
facts.sentence: If the owner changes the Stewardship Dividend Option, the dividend is no longer remitted to the original designated Approved Charity.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payment Schedule
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable annually in advance.

facts.name: Grace Period After First Premium
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies after the first premium.

facts.name: Charity Designation Change Rule
facts.sentence: The owner may change the charitable designation only to another Approved Charity.

facts.name: Charity Designation Change Window
facts.sentence: The owner may change the charitable designation only while the policy is in force.

facts.name: Loan Availability After First Year
facts.sentence: Policy loans are available after the first policy year.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 90% of the cash surrender value.

facts.name: Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The loan interest rate is 4.9% per annum.

facts.name: Policy Debt Reduces Base Face Amount
facts.sentence: Policy debt reduces the Base Face Amount.

facts.name: Policy Debt Reduces Paid-Up Additions
facts.sentence: Policy debt reduces Paid-Up Additions.

facts.name: Policy Debt Reduces Related Values
facts.sentence: Policy debt reduces other related policy values.

facts.name: Debt Impact on Charitable Percentage
facts.sentence: Policy debt does not reduce the separate charitable supplemental percentage unless required by law.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will pay the Base Face Amount to the named beneficiary or beneficiaries.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Details
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will pay Paid-Up Additions to the named beneficiary or beneficiaries.

facts.name: Death Benefit Deduction
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will subtract Policy Debt from the total death benefit.

facts.name: Charitable Benefit Payment
facts.sentence: The insurer will pay the Charitable Benefit amount directly to the named charitable organization.

facts.name: Charity Approval Requirement
facts.sentence: The named charitable organization must remain an Approved Charity at the time of claim for the Charitable Benefit to be paid.

facts.name: Non-forfeiture Options
facts.sentence: Available non-forfeiture options include cash surrender.

facts.name: Non-Forfeiture Options
facts.sentence: Available non-forfeiture options include reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: Non-Forfeiture Options
facts.sentence: Available non-forfeiture options include extended term insurance.

facts.name: Default Non-Forfeiture Rule
facts.sentence: If no election is made regarding non-forfeiture, reduced paid-up insurance will apply.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 5 years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums with 5% interest.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within 2 years from the Effective Date limits the insurer's liability to premiums paid less any debt.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age results in adjustment of the amount of insurance.

facts.name: Suicide Limitation Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide occurring within 2 years from the Effective Date limits liability to premiums paid minus any debt.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age results in adjustment of the amount of insurance.

facts.name: Charity Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: If the designated charity is not an Approved Charity at the time of claim, the charitable benefit will be paid to the owner's estate.

facts.name: Successor Charity Designation
facts.sentence: If the designated charity is not an Approved Charity at the time of claim, the charitable benefit will be paid to a successor Approved Charity only if the owner has designated one.

facts.name: Free Look Period
facts.sentence: This policy may be returned within 20 days after delivery for a full refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after 2 years during the insured's life.

facts.name: Nonpayment Contestability
facts.sentence: This policy remains subject to contestability after 2 years due to nonpayment.

facts.name: Fraud extends contestability
facts.sentence: This policy remains subject to contestability after 2 years due to fraud.

facts.name: Issuance Location
facts.sentence: Covenant Steward Life is issued at Nashville, Tennessee.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: Covenant Steward Life is issued on September 1, 2026.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Authority
facts.sentence: The President of Covenant Steward Life issued the policy.

facts.name: Supplemental Income Rider Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Supplemental Income Rider' is defined as a rider enabling scheduled policy withdrawals or loans during a designated income phase.

facts.name: Rider Limits & Sufficiency
facts.sentence: The 'Supplemental Income Rider' is subject to rider limits and policy sufficiency requirements.

facts.name: Income Phase Start Timing
facts.sentence: An 'Income Phase' begins no earlier than policy year 15.

facts.name: Income Phase Election
facts.sentence: An 'Income Phase' is elected by the policy owner.

facts.name: Overloan Protection Rider Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Overloan Protection Rider' is defined as a rider that may preserve coverage if specified debt thresholds are met.

facts.name: Overloan Protection Condition
facts.sentence: An 'Overloan Protection Rider' requires satisfaction of required rider conditions to maintain coverage preservation.

facts.name: Illustrated Value Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Illustrated Value' refers to a hypothetical projected value.

facts.name: Illustrated Value Not Guaranteed
facts.sentence: An 'Illustrated Value' is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Retirement Income Flexibility
facts.sentence: This policy is designed to offer supplemental retirement income flexibility.

facts.name: Premium Payment Duration
facts.sentence: Premiums are scheduled for 30 years.

facts.name: Non-Participating Policy Design
facts.sentence: This policy is non-participating.

facts.name: Supplemental Income Rider Attached

facts.name: Overloan Protection Rider Attached
facts.sentence: An Overloan Protection Rider is attached to the policy.

facts.sentence: Income distributions under the Supplemental Income Rider may be taken as withdrawals.

facts.sentence: Income distributions under the Supplemental Income Rider may be taken as a combination of policy loans and withdrawals.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will pay the beneficiary the base face amount.

facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will subtract policy debt from the base face amount when paying the beneficiary.

facts.sentence: Upon proof of death, the insurer will subtract withdrawals that permanently reduced face amount from the base face amount when paying the beneficiary.

facts.sentence: Any accelerated or supplemental income transaction reduces policy values as provided under the rider.

facts.sentence: After 3 full years of premium payments, the owner may elect cash surrender.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Option
facts.sentence: After 3 full years of premium payments, the owner may elect reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: Automatic Premium Loan Eligibility
facts.sentence: After 3 full years of premium payments, the owner may elect automatic premium loan if elected by endorsement.

facts.name: No Extended Term Insurance
facts.sentence: Extended term insurance is not available.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 5 years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Insurability
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Conditions
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums with 5% interest.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide within 2 years from the Effective Date limits the insurer's liability.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date
facts.sentence: Atlas Horizon Life issued the policy on October 5, 2026.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Location

facts.name: Policy Issuance Authorization

facts.name: Free Look Period

facts.name: 30-Day Full Refund

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable after 2 years during the insured's lifetime.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: After 2 years, the policy is incontestable except for nonpayment of premiums.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After 2 Years
facts.sentence: After 2 years, the policy is incontestable except for rider-specific exceptions permitted by law.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Suicide occurring within 2 years from the Effective Date limits liability.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability Limit
facts.sentence: For suicide within 2 years from the Effective Date, liability is limited to premiums paid minus withdrawals and debt.

facts.name: Misstatement of Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of sex results in adjustment of policy benefits.
